title: Conventional cockpit parameter registry
description: One record per parameter published by js/conv-engine.js. GENERATED fields (value, kind, consumers, tests, deps) are derived by tools/build-conv-parameter-registry.mjs from the engine and the pages that read it; CURATED fields (label, unit, scope, evidenceClass, source, explainKey, formula) come from data/conv-parameters.curated.json because a machine cannot know them. Regenerating must produce a byte-identical file — a drift is a ship-gate failure, not a merge conflict.

id.description: Dotted path on CONV_CALC.snapshot, e.g. cooling.chws_c. This is the primary key.

unit.description: SI unit as displayed, or null for a dimensionless ratio, an identifier, or a text value.

kind.description: authored = a constant written into the engine; derived = computed from other parameters.

value.description: Current value on the live snapshot. GENERATED — never hand-edit.

deps.description: Registry ids this parameter is computed from. Must be acyclic and every entry must resolve.

scope.description: Which physical extent the number describes. Mixing scopes across a ratio is the defect this field exists to make visible.

consumers.description: Pages that read this path. GENERATED by source grep.

tests.description: Gate files that assert on this path. GENERATED by source grep. An empty list means the parameter is untested.

docs.description: Published documentation files under manual/ or standarization/ that name this parameter by its snapshot path. GENERATED by source grep. An empty list means the parameter is undocumented — REPORTED by tools/test-conv-parameter-registry.mjs, not yet enforced.

dependsOnInputs.description: CONV_MODEL input paths that MEASURABLY move this parameter — obtained by recomputing the engine once per input with only that input perturbed. GENERATED. This is the evidence behind `deps`: a declared dependency whose measured input set is not a subset of this one does not exist.

formulaExpr.description: MACHINE-CHECKABLE form of `formula`: an arithmetic expression over registry ids, numeric literals, + - * / ( ) and ceil(). tools/test-conv-formula.mjs evaluates it and requires the result to equal the published value. This is what turns `formula` from prose into a verified claim.

formulaNotExpressible.description: Stated reason a derived parameter has no formulaExpr. Required when one is absent, so a missing expression is a documented decision rather than an omission.

display.description: 'internal' marks a parameter that deliberately has no cockpit rendering — an unrounded twin, a legacy alias, a document pointer or a branch-level label. Requires displayReason.

displayReason.description: Why this parameter is not rendered. Required whenever display is 'internal', so an unrendered parameter is a stated decision rather than an oversight.
